select count(*) as session_count, coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as finished_count, count(distinct user_id) as active_users, coalesce(sum(duration_seconds), 0) as duration_seconds from training_session where start_time >= #{from} and start_time <= #{to}

select
date_format(start_time, '%Y-%m-01') as bucket,
date_format(date_sub(start_time, interval weekday(start_time) day), '%Y-%m-%d') as bucket,
date_format(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as bucket,
count(distinct user_id) as active_users, coalesce(sum(duration_seconds), 0) as duration_seconds from training_session where start_time >= #{from} and start_time <= #{to} group by bucket
